metadata.title: Salesforce, Microsoft share gains lead Dow's nearly 475-point climb - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
Salesforce, Microsoft share gains lead Dow's nearly 475-point climb
Led by positive momentum for shares of Salesforce and Microsoft, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is climbing Thursday morning.
Shares of Salesforce Salesforce Inc. and Microsoft Microsoft Corp. are contributing around 25% of the blue-chip gauge's intraday rally, as the Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average is trading 470 points (0.9%) higher.
